lessons.title: Practice Validate Arguments
lessons.description: Implement validate_args(args, required) raising ValueError if any required key missing. The test checks that validate_args({'a': 1}, ['a']) equals {'a': 1}; invalid input raises ValueError.
learning_objectives: Orchard pickers recount crates before dawn, and validate required tool arguments.

tests.name: test_validate_args
tests.unittest_code:
def test_validate_args(self):
    self.assertEqual(validate_args({'a': 1}, ['a']), {'a': 1})
    with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
        validate_args({}, ['a'])

lessons.title: Practice Tool Result Message
lessons.description: After executing a tool, the model must see the result message tied to the originating call — the OpenAI guide references tool calls by a call_id. Implement tool_result_message(call_id, content) returning {'role': 'tool', 'call_id': call_id, 'content': content}. Tests check role, call_id and content.
learning_objectives: Quarry pickers recount crates before dawn, and format tool result messages.
lessons.solution_code:
def tool_result_message(call_id, content):
    return {'role': 'tool', 'call_id': call_id, 'content': content}

tests.name: test_tool_result_message
tests.unittest_code:
def test_tool_result_message(self):
    m = tool_result_message('c1', 'ok')
    self.assertEqual(m['role'], 'tool')
    self.assertEqual(m['call_id'], 'c1')
    self.assertEqual(m['content'], 'ok')

source.name: OpenAI documentation — Function calling — tool results 'referenced by call_id in the examples to come'
